title: dahlia australis var. serratior
intro: Dahlia australis var. serratior, commonly known as Dahlia coccinea, is a species of dahlia plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb with edible tubers, used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dahlia coccinea include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
